items.detail: Tottenham Hotspur defender Djed Spence has landed in Italy ahead of completing a move to Inter Milan.

items.headline: Sources: Reijnders exits City for $70M Saudi move
items.detail: Manchester City have agreed a deal with Al Qadsiah for midfielder Tijjani Reijnders, sources have told ESPN.

items.headline: Barthez reunited with Zidane as France GK coach
items.detail: France coach Zinedine Zidane reunited with Fabien Barthez after he was named the national team's new goalkeeper coach on Thursday.
